What to retain for each episode

A score should be traceable to a task, seed, scene, policy and terminal outcome. Save the stage transition trace for long-horizon episodes so a failed sequence can be diagnosed independently of its aggregate result.

{
  "env_id": "SharpaAngledClickMouse-v1",
  "seed": 10001,
  "scene_background": "robocasa_l3_s2",
  "checkpoint_hash": "<record actual hash>",
  "adapter_revision": "<record actual revision>",
  "success": false,
  "control_steps": 500,
  "stage_trace": [],
  "video_path": "<episode video>",
  "log_path": "<episode log>"
}

Suggested documentation record only, not a universal implemented output schema. Add the registered horizon, task fingerprint, observation configuration and background manifest from your runner.
